written.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve prototype for provable inference on Llama 4 Maverick
written.summary: Anthropic unveiled FlashProve, an open‑source system that generates cryptographic proofs that a response came from a specified model. On a single H100 GPU it produces proofs for the 400‑billion‑parameter Llama 4 Maverick at about 110 tokens per second, with proof files around 19 MB per 1,024‑token request.

written.headline: I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
written.summary: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued an advisory warning banks, NBFCs and fintech firms that attackers are using AI agents to exploit unpatched software and payment APIs for multi‑crore fraudulent transactions. It urges institutions to implement CERT‑In advisories, set transaction limits and report incidents within six hours.

written.headline: India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks
written.summary: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued an advisory warning banks, NBFCs and fintech firms that attackers are using AI agents to compromise systems and execute multi‑crore unauthorized transactions via APIs. It urges institutions to implement critical CERT‑In advisories, set transaction limits and report incidents within six hours.
